prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. One complete ACTUAL Excalidraw HELP DIALOG local component only. Image1 actual observed native help screenshot is content/control authority; Image2 PILOT is ONLY flat UI palette, density, typography and fine-divider style. Exclude underlying owner rail/whiteboard/toolbar. Natural-size Chinese/English shortcut text and readable kbd pills; extend tall canvas around1536×2048 to preserve the entire existing internally scrollable body, don't shrink/drop lists. One white dialog, source title帮助, top existing link chips 文档 / 浏览我们的博客 / 发现问题？提交反馈 / YouTube; heading快捷键列表. No added closeX/footer/Done button because actual capture has no such visible control. Standard backdrop/Escape dismissal is behavior, not a new action.
Preserve actual two-column shortcut-list structure: 工具 and then视图 in LEFT column; 编辑器 in RIGHT column. Use exact observed labels/keys below, including existing English labels; these are STATIC HELP ROWS, not clickable launch actions or extra windows. No “文档” shortcut section exists in this current vendor code/DOM:文档 is only top link, so do not invent native load/save/export shortcuts or dialogs. Help may advertise Command palette and theme shortcut as native static text; never draw an actual palette/theme chooser or claim those commands are reachable. Vendor loadScene/saveToActiveFile/export/saveAsImage remain disabled in app config; don't introduce them. External links were not followed. Flat source white/light-gray surfaces, fine borders, restrained8px UI corners; native text/key content unchanged, no ToDoo/tasks/AI/developer captions.
